title: Reporting and security
tagline: The paid deliverable and the protection of the evidence behind it.
intro: The paid deliverable and the protection of the evidence behind it.

blocks.html:
• Module: Packages/DataLayer/Sources/DataLayer/DataSources/Local/Reporting

Goal: turn a Session into a branded, signed PDF plus CSV/XLSX, shareable on the spot with no network — never truncated, never missing images, never crashing on page 38 of 40.

InOut
Branded cover, summary by severity / floor / assigneeFully custom per-company layouts (v2)
Plan pin maps, checklist tables, issue blocks with annotated photosPKI digital signatures — these are handwritten signatures with internal acceptance value, and the app says so
Before/after pairs, stale-issue section, two-party signature page
Grouping by location or by assignee (a parameter, not a second code path)
PDF + CSV/XLSX via Files / UIActivityViewController

05.1 Sections

SectionSource
Cover — project, client, dates, surveyor, logoProject + ReportBranding
Summary — counts by severity, floor, assigneeIssues
Plan pin maps, one page per sheet11
Checklist results per location13
Issue detail, before/after pairs, stale issues03, 12
SignaturesPencilKit PNG + signedAt, signerName, signerRole per party
struct ReportBranding: Codable, Sendable {
    let companyName: String
    let logoFileURL: URL?
    let accentColorHex: String
    let clientBlock: String
    let footerNote: String
}
  • Branding: one report_branding row per user; the logo uploads like any file.
  • Signing sets Session.state = .exported (read-only); re-signing creates a -R2 revision, keeps the original.

05.2 Rendering

  • UIGraphicsPDFRenderer: no third-party library, no WebView printing (HTML→PDF with 200 images gives blank pages).
Session → SessionSnapshot (one fetch) → ReportLayoutEngine (pure, no UIKit) → [ReportPage]
        → PDFPageRenderer (UIKit, one autoreleasepool per page) → temp file → atomic move → share
RuleReason
Layout counts images, renderer draws themGuarantees no dropped evidence
CGImageSourceCreateThumbnailAtIndex to maxImagePixelSize160 full-size UIImages = jetsam
Background queue; @MainActor gets progress only
Temp file + moveItemA kill mid-render never leaves a partial file
Renders the stamped, annotated derivativeThe archive keeps the clean original

Integrity on every page

  • Under each image: first 8 hash characters, the code and its state (registered/verified), time confidence when below .serverVerified.
  • Unsynced captures print "not yet verified".
  • Final page: SHA-256 over the captureID-sorted hash list.
  • Spacing, color and type come from SystemDesign tokens, inside the PDF too.

Spreadsheet

  • CSV always; XLSX above csvOnlyRowThreshold; streamed with FileHandle.
  • One row per issue: report_id, project, session_date, location_code, plan_sheet, pin_x, pin_y, issue_id, title, detail, severity, status, assignee, trade, due_date, capture_count, first_capture_sha256, verification_code, created_at.
enum ReportConstants {
    static let pageSize: CGSize = CGSize(width: 595, height: 842)   // A4 @72dpi
    static let margin: CGFloat = 40
    static let imagesPerRow: Int = 2
    static let maxImagePixelSize: CGFloat = 1400
    static let jpegCompressionQuality: CGFloat = 0.8
    static let hashPrefixLength: Int = 8
    static let staleIssueSessionThreshold: Int = 3
    static let csvOnlyRowThreshold: Int = 5000
    static let maxLogoPixelSize: CGFloat = 600
}
RiskHandling
Image missing from diskPlaceholder "Image no longer on device — {hash}"; never crash or skip
Non-ASCII file namesPercent-encode on share; test with "Ánh Dương – Block B"
Too large for chat appsShow estimated size first, offer a compression level

Done

  • 200 images / 40 issues on a low-end iPhone under 200 MB peak
  • Image count equals non-excluded capture count (asserted)
  • Pairs matched and labeled with Location.code
  • Works in airplane mode

Tests

  • Image count
  • Empty / 1 / 500 issues
  • 20-image issue paginates
  • Missing file placeholder
  • Hash-of-hashes order-stable
  • Both groupings give the same total
  • CSV escaping
  • "not yet verified"
  • Pin numbering matches detail
  • 200-image memory
  • Opens in Preview and Acrobat

blocks.html:
• Modules: SiteLog/Presentation/Access/ (FaceIDLock, PasscodeUnlock, PrivacyOverlay), SiteLog/Presentation/Settings/AppLock, DomainLayer

Goal: media and reports are unreadable if the device is lost, unmodifiable without a trace, and never leaked into logs or analytics.

07.1 At rest

DataProtection
Media, plans, upload temp partsFileProtectionType.completeUnlessOpen
SwiftData store.complete
Export bundles leaving the appAES-GCM (CryptoKit), per-bundle key
Audit chainHMAC-SHA256 (CryptoKit), key in Keychain
Firebase tokensKeychain, .whenUnlockedThisDeviceOnly

Why not AES-GCM for media

  • Background URLSession uploads only raw files on disk → encrypted media needs a plaintext temp copy for the whole upload window: worse than nothing, and double the disk.
  • .completeUnlessOpen encrypts on lock but keeps open files readable, which background upload needs.
  • .complete would stop uploads when the phone goes into a pocket.

07.2 App lock

ScreenPurpose
S4 Settings → Privacy → App lockTwo groups: Lock app, Lock after
S5Set passcode
A1Face ID unlock
A3App passcode unlock
SettingValuesDefault
Lock appOn / OffOff
Passcode6 digits, app-only; required before Lock app turns on—
Unlock with Face IDOn / Off; hidden when the device has no biometricsOn once a passcode is set
Lock afterImmediately · 1 minute · 5 minutes · 15 minutes · 1 hour5 minutes
RuleDetail
Turning onSet passcode (enter + confirm) first, then offer Face ID
Turning off, changing passcodeRequires the current passcode or Face ID
Face IDLAContext.evaluatePolicy(.deviceOwnerAuthenticationWithBiometrics); fallback button is the app passcode (Face ID fails under helmets and masks)
Biometry changedevaluatedPolicyDomainState differs from the stored one → Face ID off, passcode required
Passcode storageNever stored: PBKDF2-SHA256 + 16-byte random salt, Keychain .whenUnlockedThisDeviceOnly (not in backups)
Wrong attempts5 free, then waits of 1 · 5 · 15 · 60 min; counter and wait-until in Keychain, so killing the app does not reset them
Forgot passcodeDevice-owner check (.deviceOwnerAuthentication, device passcode) → set a new app passcode; no data erased
When it locksCold launch, and foreground return after Lock after, measured with ContinuousClock (not Date())
App switcherPrivacy overlay on resign-active while Lock app is on
  • A UI gate on RootView, not encryption (on a sheet it would be bypassable by killing the app).
  • Sensitive Keychain items use .biometryCurrentSet.

07.3 Audit log

  • Records every view, delete, export, report exclusion, metadata change, pin move, annotation edit.
struct AuditEntry: Codable, Sendable {
    let id: UUID
    let action: AuditAction
    let subjectID: String
    let actorID: String            // Firebase uid
    let occurredAt: Date
    let previousEntryHMAC: String
    let hmac: String               // HMAC-SHA256(key, canonical(fields) + previousEntryHMAC)
}
  • The chain makes edits and deletions detectable.
  • Key generated once, never leaves the device.
  • Verified at launch; a break raises a Diagnostics flag and a Crashlytics non-fatal.
  • Entries survive project deletion.
  • Losing the key on device migration is accepted: the log is per device, and Diagnostics says so.

07.4 Leaks and secrets

RuleDetail
Never log presigned URLs, tokens, Keychain valuesThey carry credentials
Never log user textLog issueID, not issue.detail (names, unit and phone numbers)
Crashlytics and analyticsIDs and enums only; no free text, no GPS
Loggeros.Logger, privacy: .private by default; no print
SecretsGoogleService-Info.plist and endpoints written by CI; .xcconfig per env, .example committed; R2 keys only on the backend
PrivacyGPS disclosed in onboarding and disableable; PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy declares location, device ID, crash data; account deletion is immediate locally, within 30 days on the server
enum SecurityConstants {
    static let lockAfterOptions: [Duration] = [.zero, .seconds(60), .seconds(300), .seconds(900), .seconds(3600)]
    static let defaultLockAfter: Duration = .seconds(300)
    static let passcodeLength: Int = 6
    static let passcodeSaltBytes: Int = 16
    static let passcodePBKDF2Rounds: UInt32 = 210_000
    static let freePasscodeAttempts: Int = 5
    static let passcodeLockoutSteps: [Duration] = [.seconds(60), .seconds(300), .seconds(900), .seconds(3600)]
    static let keychainService: String = "app.dd.site.log.keys"
    static let auditHMACKeyTag: String = "app.dd.site.log.audit.hmac"
    static let exportKeyLengthBytes: Int = 32
}

Done

  • A locked device's media is unreadable via file sharing or unencrypted backup
  • Background upload continues while locked
  • A hand-edited entry fails at the right index
  • No print(
  • A 20-photo session's logs hold no URL, token or free text

Tests

  • 100-entry chain verifies
  • Edit at 50 and mid-chain deletion detected at the right index
  • AES-GCM bundle round-trip
  • Wrong key throws
  • New files carry the expected protection
  • .biometryCurrentSet unreadable before auth
  • Redaction snapshot
  • Passcode hash round-trip and wrong passcode rejected
  • Lockout steps survive relaunch
  • Lock after boundary (just under / at the value)
  • Biometry change turns Face ID off
